description.p: This app is a desktop client for accessing NetXMS v6.2.x server.
NetXMS is an enterprise grade multi-platform modular open source network management and monitoring system.
It provides comprehensive event management, performance monitoring, alerting, reporting and graphing for all layers of IT infrastructure — from network devices to business application layer.
Having been designed with flexibility and scalability in mind, NetXMS features a wide range of supported platforms.
It is licensed under the GNU General Public License version 2 as published by the Free Software Foundation.

ul.li: Added subagent for reading electricity grid data (including carbon intensity) from ENTSO-E Transparency Platform
